gen-gf-grandstander-fs-amulya: Amulya reads modern and unhurried, its curves leaving generous gaps and its lowercase staying moderate in height. And Grandstander, with cable-like strokes and a tall lowercase, shouts up top while a long paragraph of Amulya stays easy going.
gen-gf-grandstander-fs-chillax: Grandstander is bold and expressive, its strokes drawn plain and constant. Chillax, a sans with spaghetti-like lines and loops left unfinished, loosens the mood, so a long run of text feels casual and relaxed.
gen-gf-grandstander-fs-plein: Loud and friendly: Grandstander keeps stems and joins at one thickness, tall in the lowercase, while Plein stays low and clear. Plein's clear channel into each round letter keeps paragraphs smooth.
gen-gf-grandstander-fs-synonym: Strokes of constant thickness and a tall lowercase give Grandstander its bold, expressive swagger. Synonym, a sans laying down a plain stripe of ink, keeps generous openings in every curve, so lines run dependably.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-alumni-sans: Grandstander is all bold swagger, with strokes that never pinch at the curves. Alumni Sans, a plain sans with barely-there thick-thin contrast, is the one to lean on for clean, approachable text.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-courier-prime: Loud meets precise, with a bold display face above a monospace body. Grandstander does best at expressive, tall-lowercase shouting, while Courier Prime does best at steady, drafting-pen structure with generous round mouths.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-geom: Round, loud and unfussy: Grandstander has no calligraphic swelling in its outlines. Geom, a contemporary sans, then settles in beneath with a lofty lowercase band, leaving the shouting to the heading.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-inder: Loud shapes up top, quiet type below. What they share is uniformity: Grandstander holds line width constant through curves and straights, while Inder, a professional sans-serif, keeps its cases close in height.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-magra: Round bowls that never swell or thin lead the way here. Heft is the shared quality: Grandstander's constant strokes up top, then Magra, plain sans through and through, with big-bodied lowercase.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-major-mono-displa: Solid, constant strokes above and neon-glass tubes of monospace below. Grandstander stays bold and expressive with its open curves, while Major Mono Display spaces its precise letters widely, so the two trade loudness for precision.
